messages:
aline: quick pass on audit-and-data-lifecycle.md  I sketched a retention matrix for different data classes (audit logs, embeddings, traces, prompt meta). want feedback before i open the PR.

jon: nice. what's your thinking for embeddings vs audit logs? they often get conflated.

aline: proposal: default retention matrix in docs:
- audit_logs: 365 days
- embeddings: 90 days (unless customer opts into longer analytic retention)
- model_traces (llm internal traces): 30 days
- prompt_metadata (ids, pseudonyms): 365 days
Also recommend an explicit per-tenant override via the API.

priya: two security notes: 1) never show full prompt text in public examples; 2) show how to store prompt references using KMS-wrapped ids so raw content lives in an encrypted vault.

aline: agreed. example snippet I want to add (JS pseudocode):
```js
// store a prompt separately, keep reference in audit record
const promptRef = await kms.wrap(plainPrompt, {keyId: 'projects/..../key1'}) // returns prompt_id
await client.audit.create({
  action: 'generate',
  prompt_id: promptRef,
  retention_policy: {type: 'days', value: 365}
})
```
This shows `retention_policy` as a tiny structured option rather than multiple ad-hoc field names.

security: structured `retention_policy` is fine but for SOC2-friendly wording avoid `permanent`. use "retained for N days" in prose. Also add a clear sentence that retrieval of raw prompts requires audited admin approval and KMS unwrap events.

priya: can we include a short migration section that maps older fields to the new shape? e.g., `expires_at` (ISO) -> `retention_policy: {type: 'days', value: X}` and `ttl_seconds` -> same. that'll help customers migrating.

aline: yes. i'll add a small table mapping old -> new and a note on timezone conversion caveats.

jon: important: embeddings are often treated as irreversible, so call out that if customers insist on longer embedding retention they should store them in a customer-managed bucket with KMS and opt-in flags. docs should show the recommended default and the opt-in path.

compliance-bot: reminder: SOC2 reviewers prefer concrete ranges and avoid absolutes. Suggested phrase: "Records are retained for N days and may be retained longer for legal hold or investigations." Link to internal retention playbook: (internal) https://redwood-internal.company/retention-playbook.

aline: i'll add that exact sentence near the matrix. also plan to add a short FAQ: "why 90 days for embeddings?" explaining re-identification risk and cost tradeoffs.

priya: please also add a docs-lint rule that flags `prompt:` or `prompt_text:` in examples and fails CI if present. we had a regression that slipped in last quarter.

jon: agree. small grep in docs CI should do it. add a unit test that parses examples and validates presence of `retention_policy` where appropriate.

doc-ci: PR created by aline: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 - "docs(security): add retention matrix + KMS-wrapped prompt_id snippet + migration map" (CI: docs-build running)

priya: i'll review wording for the KMS snippet and confirm SOC2 phrasing. security, please verify the admin unwrap flow wording is accurate.

security: will review. one nit: in the code example prefer `prompt_id` string value format `pmt|<base64>` so it's clear it's not raw text. also add a one-liner about audit logs capturing KMS unwrap events.

aline: excellent. once security/compliance approve i'll squash-merge. CHANGELOG line proposed: "docs(security): add retention matrix for data classes; show KMS-wrapped prompt_id pattern; migration mapping for legacy retention fields"

jon: tiny UX nit: make the matrix machine-readable (YAML table) so product and sales can copy-paste into customer contracts.

aline: will include a YAML snippet under the table. thanks all, opening PR now for review.
